policy.purpose: Tracked upstream source snapshots for auditable local research; reference repositories never participate in product build/package/runtime.
policy.copying: No direct product-code adaptation is approved by this bootstrap commit.
policy.proprietarySources: SOLIDWORKS binaries, confidential drawing PDFs and copyrighted manuals remain local and are never copied into this repository.
policy.storage: Tracked source snapshots without nested .git metadata; ignored working checkouts live under references/.checkouts.

repositories.name: jaylamping/solidworks-mcp
repositories.role: STA worker, COM session safety, checkpoints and assembly coverage reference.
capabilities: Dedicated COM worker process and session protocol
Running Object Table discovery and process identity
Command safety metadata and path allowlists
adoptedIdeas: Process-bound session identity and explicit command safety metadata
Separate COM worker boundary as an architectural reference
Allowlist and generated-catalog concepts, reimplemented in C# domain types
rejectedIdeas: Node.js and JavaScript as a required product runtime
Direct adaptation of upstream worker code
Treating generated docs or screenshots as geometry proof

repositories.name: czuryk/SolidworksMCP
repositories.role: Transaction, invariant, rollback and geometry-verification reference.
capabilities: COM utility normalization and modal detection
adoptedIdeas: Inspect/rebuild/verify as a compound operation contract
Unit conversion at the CAD boundary
Separate installation discovery from feature execution
rejectedIdeas: Python, pywin32, and Pythoncom as a product dependency
Unbounded dynamic tool or eval-style dispatch

repositories.name: Slacker-LLC/solidworks-mcp
repositories.role: Drawing API, explicit units, declarative selection and screenshot evidence reference.
adoptedIdeas: Keep drawing operations separate from general document lifecycle
Use installed type-library information before implementing COM calls
Preserve upstream NOTICE obligations in reference metadata
rejectedIdeas: Python runtime and dynamic dispatch as the production chain
Unverified annotation mutation without coverage evidence
Treating a screenshot as the primary CAD correctness assertion

repositories.name: hjbaard/SolidWorks-MCP
capabilities: Non-trivial bracket, hole and pattern examples
adoptedIdeas: Use small feature-focused fixtures for live verification
Keep unit conversion at the session boundary
rejectedIdeas: Python and pywin32 as a required runtime
Unbounded cancellation assumptions for an in-flight COM call
Directly reusing scripts as production implementation

repositories.name: modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk
repositories.role: Official MCP C# SDK source and stdio/DI contract reference.
capabilities: Official MCP C# server builder and DI integration
adoptedIdeas: Use the official C# SDK boundary for stdio MCP hosting
Model transport behavior from upstream conformance tests
rejectedIdeas: Copying SDK implementation into the product
Using the reference checkout as a build dependency
